snippet.title: The Birdsong Tree | Official Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
The Birdsong Tree
A cozy building and light simulation game where you observe birds, create custom birdhouses, and help a living urban tree grow. Balance sound, diversity, and neighbor reactions as you shape a calm, reactive environment.
